roles.blurb: Custom AI-native software for healthcare, construction, and education clients — dedicated subagents, harness-controlled execution, persistent memory (Engram), and a full SDD cycle.

groups.heading: AI-Native Development
items: Built every project on a human-in-control AI architecture: subagents per domain, harnesses governing each process, Engram preserving context across engagements.
Applied SDD on every project: 0 TypeScript errors in production, every critical path unit-tested before release.
Built production RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase pgvector, Gemini text-embedding-005) for semantic search over client knowledge bases.
Delivered a full production platform in one week (CocinerHosp), applying the AI methodology end to end — architecture through debugging.

groups.heading: Product Engineering
items: Delivered 3 enterprise-grade platforms in 2026 (web apps, PWAs, management systems), each replacing a manual operation and cutting operational time 30–100%.
Architected server-side RBAC with Supabase Auth + RLS — zero reported security incidents across all platforms.
Cut average client time-on-task from 30 minutes to 2 on production workflows.

roles.blurb: Independent full-stack development for services, non-profit, healthcare, and market-research clients — evolved from traditional development to AI-augmented workflows.

items: Built enterprise management systems with React, Node.js, Express, and MySQL — RESTful APIs with controller/service architecture and Sequelize ORM.

Coordinated projects and field teams across 5 Latin American countries simultaneously.

featured.name: Construction Budget Platform
featured.summary: A construction firm operating remotely from the US managed its entire budget cycle — quotes, approvals, execution, close-out — via Excel and WhatsApp, with no real-time cost visibility. Full-stack platform centralizing the entire project lifecycle: guided approval flows by role, real-time cost tracking (budgeted vs. actual per line item with traffic-light alerts), one-click PDF generation for clients, and a live profitability dashboard the owner accesses from the US.

featured.name: SpeakPath
featured.summary: An English academy running ~120 classes/month on manual scheduling (WhatsApp), static PDF content, and no financial visibility — with chronic double-bookings and zero data on teacher utilization or student progress. Full-stack PWA with three role-based panels (student, teacher, admin): automated 1-on-1 scheduling with real-time teacher availability and timezone support, interactive lesson content replacing PDFs, teacher earnings dashboard, and admin metrics in one place.

screens.caption: Student dashboard tracking course progress across the full curriculum.

screens.label: Curriculum
screens.caption: 6 units / 25 lessons, from "Meeting People" to "Daily Life".

featured.name: CocinerHosp
featured.summary: A hospital catering company serving 6 centers and 2 daily services was calculating production quantities manually — proteins, portions, frozen bag counts, dietary variants — with systematic error risk at scale. Mobile-first PWA (iOS + Android, no app store) built in one week. Automated production calculator with auto-populated waste factors, dietary module for soft diets, recipe scaling engine, production register, and analytics dashboard with per-chef filtering. 3-role access managed in-app.

screens.label: Dashboard
screens.caption: 526 barquetas this month, 75 avg/day, 19 elaboraciones, weekly and monthly production charts.
